[[Skeleton]] | usage = Building, Crafting | weight = 1.0 | stack = 50 | teleport = Yes }} '''Ice''' is a [[material]] found in the [[Deep North]]. == Availability == * Dropped from [[Ice Sheet]]s on the shore of the [[Deep North]]. * Dropped from [[Ice Pond]] in Deep North. * Dropped from [[Greydwarf (Deep North)|Greydwarfs]] and [[Greydwarf Shaman (Deep North)|Greydwarf Shamans]] in the Deep North. * Dropped from [[Skeleton]]s in the Deep North. * Dropped when destroying various ice shards and frozen objects in the Deep North. {{drop table|title=Creature| {{drop row|item=Greydwarf|link=Greydwarf (Deep North)|0star=1|1star=2|2star=4}} {{drop row|item=Greydwarf Shaman|link=Greydwarf Shaman (Deep North)|0star=1|1star=2|2star=4}} {{drop row|item=Skeleton|0star=1|1star=2|2star=4}} }} Objects that are mined in fragments (Ice Sheets, Ice Ponds and ShimmeringSand_rock) drop their Ice for each fragment destroyed. The IceShard objects can only be damaged by pickaxes. {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" ! Object ID !! Rolls !! Amount per roll |- | IceShore_frac || 2-3 per fragment || 1 |- | IcePond_rock_frac || 1-3 per fragment || 1 |- | ShimmeringSand_rock_frac || 1-3 per fragment || 1 |- | IceShard_01, IceShard_02, IceShard_03 || 1-2 || 3-5 |- | IceShard_04, BlackIceShard_01 || 1-2 || 1 |- | IceShard_05, IceShard_06, BlackIceShard_02 || 1-2 || 1-3 |- | FrozenGD, FrozenSkeleton_Pose1, FrozenSkeleton_Pose2 || 1-3, each result at most once || 1 Ice, 1-2 Ice, or 1 [[Resin]] |- | ice1 || 3-5 || 1 |} == Usage == ===Building=== * {{Item link|Ice Block}} x2 * {{Item link|Frigid Kiln}} x5 ===Crafting=== * {{Item link|Bloodgold Payload}} x2 * {{Item link|Cast Northern Vengeance}} x10 * {{Item link|Lingonberry Juice}} x5 * {{Item link|Oat Milk}} x5 * {{Item link|Fish Soup}} x2 * {{Item link|Seal Meat Soup}} x2 * {{Item link|Snowball}} x5 ===Upgrade=== * {{Item link|Northern Vengeance}} ===Fuel=== * Ice is the fuel of the [[Frigid Kiln]], which turns five Ice into one [[Liquid Frost]] every 30 seconds and holds up to 25 Ice. Liquid Frost is used to turn [[Moulds|casts]] into weapons and armor in a [[Frost Foundry]]. {{MaterialsNav}}
